summary: Concept-level explainer for the notebook loop: a four-station ring figure (learn/anchor/check/recall) built as inline SVG, then four cards for what happens to a note when its file changes. The four state strings it prints — [fresh], [evidence changed], [moved -> new/path], [anchor missing] — are hand-copied from freshnessLine() in src/kb/freshness.ts and nothing enforces the match, so a change to those rendered strings must be mirrored here by hand. Ring geometry: centre 380,300 radius 170 in a viewBox cropped to the content bounds; the label baselines are hand-tuned for equal optical gaps, so moving a node means recomputing the crop rather than nudging by eye.
